index.title: Record your matches with FargoRate
index.description: A web app that helps you enter and review pool match scores on top of FargoRate ratings. Your FargoRate ID is all you need to get started.

link.title: Link your FargoRate
link.description: Enter the 13-digit FargoRate ID shown on your player card in the FargoRate app to link your FargoRate player profile. The screen also shows you where to find it.

guest.title: Start as a guest
guest.description: No FargoRate ID? Enter a name and a rating to get started. The name is optional.

lookup.title: Lookup a Player
lookup.description: Look up FargoRate players by name to check their rating and robustness. Useful when you want a sense of how strong an opponent is.

index.lead: A web app that supports pool matches played on FargoRate. It helps you enter scores during a match and look back on how your matches went.
index.start: Get started with your FargoRate ID

record.title: Keep score in your hand
record.description: Enter the score as the match goes. No paper, no chalk marks, and no arguing about where the score stands.

review.title: Look back on your results
review.description: Revisit the matches you have played. See who you played, how often, and how each one turned out.

rating.title: Use FargoRate numbers as they are
rating.description: Ratings and robustness come straight from the official FargoRate system. Nothing is self-reported, so players meeting for the first time can still agree on where they stand.

index.aboutBody: A rating system that puts the skill of pocket billiards players worldwide on a single common scale. Ratings are built from wins, losses, and score margins, so players can be compared on the same scale across countries, regions, and leagues. They update automatically as results arrive from affiliated leagues and tournaments.

advanced.note: The stronger end of the amateur field

professional.note: Leading pros and the best in the world

index.gettingStartedBody: Just enter the 13-digit FargoRate ID shown on your player card in the FargoRate app. There is no password to register, and the linking screen shows you how to find your ID.
index.gettingStartedNote: This app reads your rating from FargoRate, but it never sends match results to the official system. Nothing you record here changes your rating.
